title: Unblock main: zstd advisory and the GMCP-013-06 latency budget
goal: Every pull request now fails the required cargo deny check on a zstd-sys advisory (upgrade to 2.1.2+), and main is red on GMCP-013-06 because its ten second per-request budget fails under the loaded full suite. Bump zstd-sys in Cargo.lock and relax the test budget to sixty seconds so the merge queue can drain and main is green again.
